title: Sara Duterte the best defense witness in impeachment trial, says prosecutor Luistro
summary: House Lead Impeachment Prosecutor Rep Gerville Luistro on Tuesday said Vice President Sara Duterte is the best witness that the defense panel can present in the impeachment trial.

blocks.text: House Lead Impeachment Prosecutor Rep Gerville Luistro on Tuesday said Vice President Sara Duterte is the best witness that the defense panel can present in the impeachment trial.

"Basing it on the witnesses I have seen so far from the defense, it appears to us na talagang isa lang ang may kakayanang magpaliwanag ng lahat ng ito (there is only one person who can explain all these). And that is the respondent vice president," Luistro said in an interview today.

"So I hope that she avails of this opportunity para maipaliwanag ang kanyang sagot or depensa dito sa mga (to explain her answers or defense regarding these) specific allegations of the prosecution. After all, she has repeatedly said that she will be answering in the proper forum. This is the proper and the best forum," Luistro added.
The legislator from the second district of Batangas is hoping that the next batch of defense witnesses will give testimony that will be relevant.

She said that it is the defense panel's exclusive prerogative to choose which witnesses and documents to present but "we can't help but expect explosive evidence. But that explosive evidence, we haven't seen."
Luistro said the Vice President "should be able to give a reasonable explanation to the Filipino people on why there are specific allegations by the prosecution."
She said Duterte should explain the P817 million in assets that were not declared.
Luistro believes it is possible to conclude the impeachment trial before Congress goes on recess on Dec 19.

"Well, what I can say is I look forward to the conclusion of this process... We have spent so much time on this and I think this is high time for us to put a closure on all of this and for the Filipino people to move on," Luistro said. —NB, GMA News
